quiet.description: true when no watched company reported inside the window: reports is then empty

reports.description: one per company that reported inside the window, largest guidance change, surprise or stock move first

ticker.description: the ticker with its exchange when it is ambiguous

period.description: the fiscal period as the company labels it, such as Q3 FY2026, quarter ended Sep 30

headline.description: revenue and EPS as reported, with the basis, and the GAAP or IFRS figure beside any adjusted one

expected_source.description: the named consensus source and the date it was compiled, or the words consensus not verified, or guidance or prior year when that was the comparison

change.description: maintained means the company said so, never silence: silence is not_given

text.description: word for word from the transcript or release you read

qa_themes.description: themes of the analyst questions; empty when no transcript or replay could be read

stock_reaction.description: a percentage with its date and session and the source, such as fell 6.2% on Oct 29, first full session after results, per Nasdaq; null when not verified

material_items.description: buybacks, dividend changes, restructurings, impairments, executive or auditor changes disclosed with results

so_what.description: what it means against the focus or the benchmark; facts only, no advice

source_urls.description: the release, filing or transcript pages read, the primary one first

moves.description: the price recap for watched tickers that did not report; empty when recap is off

change.description: a percentage over the window, such as -3.1%

as_of.description: the date and session, such as close Nov 13

driver.description: the cause with its link, or the words no identified driver. Never inferred from timing alone

not_reported.description: watched companies with no results inside the window, or whose quarter an earlier report already covered

unresolved.description: entries that are not a listed company or could not be resolved to one

report_markdown.description: what a person reads: the single most consequential result first as a claim with a number, then one short section per report, then the recap lines and one line naming companies that did not report
